condition: Post-operative pneumonia with NEWS2 ≥7 — ward escalation
summary: 69-year-old man with COPD, day 3 after laparotomy for a perforated duodenal ulcer: RR 28, SpO₂ 89% on 2 L oxygen, HR 112, BP 104/62, T 38.4°C, new confusion — NEWS2 15.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Breathless with a cough and new confusion after abdominal operation
inputs.hpi: Day 3 after laparotomy and omental patch repair of a perforated duodenal ulcer. COPD (FEV1 55%), smoker. Productive cough with green sputum since last night, increasingly breathless, new confusion this morning. Not using the incentive spirometer because of wound pain.

exam.general: Tachypnoeic, confused (new). HR 112, BP 104/62, RR 28, SpO2 89% on 2 L nasal oxygen, T 38.4°C.
exam.respiratory: Coarse crackles and bronchial breathing at the right base.

imaging.name: Chest X-ray (portable)
imaging.result: Right lower lobe consolidation. No free subdiaphragmatic gas beyond expected post-operative. No pneumothorax.

surgicalHistory: Laparotomy and omental patch repair of perforated DU (day 3)

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Hospital-acquired pneumonia (right lower lobe) with sepsis — day 3 after laparotomy; NEWS2 15
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Post-operative right lower lobe pneumonia with sepsis and new confusion, NEWS2 15. Emergency response: critical care outreach/ICU review, cultures and antibiotics, controlled oxygen (COPD: target 88–92% pending ABG).

mustExclude.note: COPD: target 88–92% until blood gases are known (hypercapnic risk). Quality because hypercapnia is not yet established.
No generalised peritonitis or perforation: an emergency-laparotomy consent line is a wrong-procedure suggestion.
mustExclude.proposedFix: Negation-aware matching (NegEx-style) in clinical-inference.ts exam()/hasRadResult() and triage rules.ts (see findings/hpb.md gap 1); gate operative-plan cascades on the working diagnosis.

mustExclude.note: Not an appendix presentation: an appendicectomy operative plan (consent, theatre booking, post-operative orders) is a wrong-procedure suggestion.

guideline.name: RCP — National Early Warning Score (NEWS) 2
guideline.section: Aggregate ≥7: emergency response — urgent assessment by a team with critical-care competencies, continuous monitoring; 5–6 or a single red parameter: urgent response
guideline.citation: Royal College of Physicians. National Early Warning Score (NEWS) 2. London: RCP; 2017.

guideline.name: BTS guideline — oxygen use in adults in healthcare and emergency settings
guideline.section: Target SpO₂ 94–98% for most; 88–92% for people at risk of hypercapnic respiratory failure (e.g. COPD) pending blood gases
guideline.citation: O'Driscoll BR, Howard LS, Earis J, Mak V. Thorax. 2017;72(Suppl 1):ii1–90.

guideline.name: NICE NG139 — Pneumonia (hospital-acquired): antimicrobial prescribing
guideline.section: Start antibiotics as soon as possible after diagnosis in people with hospital-acquired pneumonia; choice by severity and risk of resistance
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Pneumonia (hospital-acquired): antimicrobial prescribing (NG139). London: NICE; 2019.

guideline.name: Surviving Sepsis Campaign — international guidelines 2021
guideline.section: Antimicrobials within 1 h for possible septic shock or high likelihood of sepsis; source control as soon as practical; measure lactate; admit to ICU when needed
guideline.citation: Evans L, Rhodes A, Alhazzani W, et al. Crit Care Med. 2021;49:e1063–143.

rationale: Base NEWS2-escalation case: post-operative pneumonia with a NEWS2 of 15 in a COPD patient. Tests emergency response, hypoxia alarm, escalation, antibiotics, blood gas and controlled oxygen.
